core.title: C Shape Door Pull, First Impressions C9x4.5

text.description_html:
First Impressions 9 Inch "C" Door Pull

This sleek 9 " high pull is made from solid brass and is great for entry doors, commercial doors, or large furniture. They come complete with all necessary hardware for thru-bolt mounting.

This "C" Door Pull is available in other sizes and finishes, Contact Us for more information.

Impeccably crafted from high grade 3/8" thick solid brass and finished in oil rubbed bronze.

Specifications: of First Impressions "C" Door Pull

  • Overall Height: 9"
  • Overall Width of C: 4.5"
  • Thickness: 3/8"
  • Width of pull: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"

Note: This beautiful door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door).

*Sold individually (1 door pull).
